gendarmerie.definition: n. French police force; a group of gendarmes or gendarmes collectively
gendarmerie.translation: [法] 宪兵队, 宪兵警察

gendarmery.translation:
n. 〈外〉宪兵队
[网络] 国家宪兵；法国宪兵；国家地方警察

gendarmes.translation: n. 宪兵, 警官( gendarme的名词复数 )

gender.definition: n. a grammatical category in inflected languages governing the agreement between nouns and pronouns and adjectives; in some languages it is quite arbitrary but in Indo-European languages it is usually based on sex or animateness

gender bender.translation: 穿着举止像异性的人；假小子（或假娘们）

gender dysphoria.translation: 性别焦虑症；性别认同障碍

gender ninja.definition:
a person who's gender is indecipherable
> Person 1: Is that a dude or a chick?
> Person 2: I dunno. I haven't seen a gender ninja like that since the days of [Hansen].

gender reassignment.translation: 性别再造手术；变性手术

gender-bender.translation: n. <俚>（歌手或艺人）男扮女装者或女扮男装者

gender-specific.translation: 女（或男）性特有的；与某一性别有关的

gendered.translation: a. 依照性别而分类的

gendering.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Gender
gendering.translation:
n. 性；性别；性交
vt. 生（过去式gendered, 过去分词gendered, 现在分词gendering, 第三人称单数genders, 形容词genderless）

genders.definition:
n. a grammatical category in inflected languages governing the agreement between nouns and pronouns and adjectives; in some languages it is quite arbitrary but in Indo-European languages it is usually based on sex or animateness
n. the properties that distinguish organisms on the basis of their reproductive roles
genders.translation: n. <语>性某些语言的（阳性、阴性和中性, 不同的性有不同的词尾等）( gender的复数形式 ); 性别; 某些语言的（名词、代词和形容词）性的区分
